text: Which of the following correctly describes the time complexity of accessing an element in a hash map (average case)?
referenceAnswer: Hash maps use a hash function to compute a key's index, giving O(1) average-case access. Collisions can degrade this to O(n) worst case.

text: In React, what is the primary purpose of the useEffect hook?
options: B. To perform side effects after render
referenceAnswer: useEffect runs side effects (data fetching, subscriptions, DOM mutations) after render. The dependency array controls when it re-runs.

text: Which HTTP status code indicates that a resource was successfully created?
referenceAnswer: 201 Created is returned when a POST request successfully creates a resource.

text: Which Python data structure maintains insertion order and allows duplicate values?
referenceAnswer: Python lists are ordered and allow duplicates. Sets are unordered and deduplicate; dict keys must be unique.

text: In MongoDB, which query finds documents where 'age' is greater than 25?
referenceAnswer: MongoDB uses $ operators for comparisons. $gt means 'greater than'. Syntax: { field: { $operator: value } }.

text: What does the 'S' in SOLID principles stand for?
referenceAnswer: S = Single Responsibility Principle: a class should have only one reason to change.

text: In machine learning, what is overfitting?
options: A. Model performs well on training data but poorly on new data
B. Model performs poorly on both training and test data
C. Model takes too long to train
D. Model uses too many features
referenceAnswer: Overfitting occurs when a model learns training data noise too well, reducing generalisation to unseen data.

text: Which Docker command builds an image from a Dockerfile?
referenceAnswer: docker build reads the Dockerfile and creates an image. docker run creates and starts a container from an existing image.

text: What is the purpose of the 'async/await' syntax in JavaScript?
options: B. To write asynchronous code that reads like synchronous code
D. To delay function execution by a fixed time
referenceAnswer: async/await is syntactic sugar over Promises. It allows asynchronous code to be written in a sequential, readable style without chaining .then().

text: Which AWS service is best suited for storing large unstructured files like images and videos?
referenceAnswer: Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) is object storage designed for storing and retrieving any amount of unstructured data.
